shared_or_similar_visual_information: A line or boundary made of separated short strokes.
mathematical_meanings: Left image: They represent rear edges of the solid that are hidden from this viewing direction. Right image: It marks an interior subdivision of the planar figure, rather than a hidden edge of a solid.
Rationales: The left dashes convey occlusion in a three-dimensional wireframe. The right dashes subdivide the interior of a flat composite outline and are distinct from its outer perimeter. The two stroke styles therefore encode different contextual functions.
